name: Gol-Kaa
description: Traditional language of Goliath communities, preserved through an ancient oral tradition. It is distinct from the Giant language; the languages' historical relationship and mutual intelligibility remain unspecified.
reviewNotes: Gol-Kaa is attested in Races of Stone (3.5e): it has thirteen phonetic elements and a longstanding oral tradition; some communities later adopted the Dwarvish alphabet.
Giant is listed separately as an optional Goliath language in 3.5e. Do not assume the languages are interchangeable or that one descends from the other.
The General Goliath Upbringing grants this learned language; biological Goliath Species does not automatically do so.
Future global language reconciliation may refine scripts and language families without removing the selected Gol-Kaa definition.
